# VoxFrame 2.2.1 — the new studio, ready to download

This patch packages the complete 2.2 studio improvements and corrects a release
check that mistook documentation about duplicate and size limits for an API key.
The exception applies to that exact historical finding; the full secret scan
remains enabled. Future failed scans attach a redacted report.

## Studio improvements

- Keep or remove exact video sections in Pacing, with Undo and Redo.
- Edit added music independently and download separate voice and music WAVs.
- Compose stories, direct visuals, compare looks and save reusable signatures.
- Build bookend collections, review finished clips and download their delivery ZIPs.
- Improved model switching, media downloads, exact transition lengths, project
  deletion and responsive studio layouts.

For the complete feature details and audio/caption limitations, see the
[2.2.0 feature notes](https://github.com/Ngum12/voxframe/blob/main/.github/release-notes/v2.2.0.md).

## Downloads

The release workflow builds and tests the Windows installer and macOS Apple
Silicon DMG, attaches checksums and bundled FFmpeg source, and creates a draft
release for the maintainer to review and publish.
